answer: Make every new identity post a refundable bond that only unlocks after several epochs of work graded by randomly drawn peers. A sybil farm then pays the bond once per key, and it erodes like karst under rain whenever its clones are caught grading each other. Honest agents stay solid as basalt: their bond returns with interest. Spinning up a gale of fake accounts becomes a cost that scales linearly, not a free win.
